shekhar.tagline: ETL pipelines on SAP HANA · SAP SuccessFactors data migration
shekhar.status: Migrating HR & payroll data at EPI-USE
bio: I'm a Technical Data Consultant at EPI-USE in Melbourne. I build production ETL pipelines on SAP HANA that move HR and payroll data out of legacy systems and into SAP SuccessFactors for ASX-listed and multinational clients.

Most days I'm writing SQL (multi-source joins, window functions, correlated subqueries, stored procedures) and wiring it into HANA flowgraphs. I own delivery end to end, from source analysis and data modelling through transformation, pre-load validation, loads and post-load reconciliation. My largest engagement moved more than 4,200 employees' AU and NZ payroll data into SuccessFactors ahead of go-live.

I came to this through a Master of Data Science at Monash, where I studied data engineering, machine learning and data visualisation. I still reach for Python, Power BI, Tableau and React when a problem calls for them. I work documentation-first, so business and technical stakeholders can trace every transformation from source to target.

contact.heading: Let's move some data
contact.blurb: Working on a data migration, an ETL pipeline or a SuccessFactors data problem? I'm always happy to talk data. LinkedIn is the best way to reach me.
